name: html-vector-editor
description: A vector editor drawn with WebGL 2 that exports the same picture as SVG, a GLSL shader and PNG — as one standalone HTML file

scripts.test: node tests/matrix.mjs && node tests/model.mjs && node tests/geometry.mjs && node tests/serialize.mjs && node tests/svg.mjs && node tests/glsl.mjs && node tests/font.mjs && node tests/text.mjs
scripts.shots: node build.mjs && mkdir -p shots && node --experimental-websocket tests/app.mjs --shots shots
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:browser
